Function Name: is_equal_to_sum_even  
Description: Determines whether a given integer n can be expressed as the sum of exactly four positive even integers.  
Parameters:  
- n (integer): The number to evaluate.  

Example:  
- is_equal_to_sum_even(8)   → true   (8 = 2 + 2 + 2 + 2)  
- is_equal_to_sum_even(10)  → true   (10 = 2 + 2 + 2 + 4)  
- is_equal_to_sum_even(7)   → false  (odd, cannot be sum of even numbers)  
- is_equal_to_sum_even(6)   → false  (smallest sum of four positive evens is 8)
